spec.claim_summary: Buying Bitcoin when price drops below the 200-week moving average is presented as a buying opportunity.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: Asset BTCUSDT mapped from claimant mention of Bitcoin.
Timeframe 1d taken from page chart context, not stated by claimant.
Moving-average type not stated, assumed SMA as usual default.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: true 200-week average of weekly closes; approximated as daily SMA(1400) (200*7) on 1d bars.
Entry compiled as crosses_below trigger from falls below / drops below automatic buy-order language.
Claim gives no exit; using max_hold_bars 1460 (~4 years) as buy-and-hold proxy to mimic March 2020 to 2024 example.

evidence.quote: When Bitcoin's price falls below its 200-week moving average
set buy orders to trigger automatically when Bitcoin's price drops below this threshold
